fact: The Civil Status Office announced on 24 June 2026 that from 29 June 2026 the Rose Belle Civil Status Office would move to the Vieux Moulin Commercial Centre and also operate as a Single Point Office, where death registration, death certificates and burial or cremation permits are completed under one roof by Civil Status Division, Public Health Office and local authority officers; it says nothing of the CSD System.
title: Communique: Relocation of Rose Belle Civil Status Office
publisher: Civil Status Office, Prime Minister's Office
